decision.observation: The farmer stands at the western edge of a broad paved plaza. A building is visible to the northeast; no festival stalls or crowds are visible. It is Saturday 13 at 2:50 pm.
decision.hypothesis: Moving east across the plaza should reveal more of the town square and whether any festival activity remains.
decision.memory: The festival was announced this morning, but no festival scene has been reached. Today's seven planted tiles received watering animations.
